description.value:
Prerequisites: Unhindered Movement warrior talent, Strength 17

The warrior may choose to be considered one size larger for the purpose of what combat maneuvers he can affect enemies with, and what maneuvers and special abilities enemies can affect him with. He does not take penalties for using weapons of inappropriate size. This talent does not affect weapon damage or the warrior's actual size.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Advanced Warrior Talents
